name: OpenAIR
what: A large library of real spaces: churches, halls, heritage buildings, outdoor sites and more.
formats: Stereo, B-format and 5.1, depending on the room
licence: Most rooms are Creative Commons, but the contributor of each room picks its licence. Check the licence shown on each room's page before using it.

name: MAIR (Microphone Array Impulse Responses)
by: Applied Psychoacoustics Lab, University of Huddersfield
what: Rooms captured with many microphone arrays, from 2-channel stereo to 9-channel surround with height.
licence: CC-BY 4.0: free to use, with credit to the University of Huddersfield.

name: 3D-MARCo
by: Applied Psychoacoustics Lab, University of Huddersfield
what: Room impulse responses from St. Paul's concert hall, Huddersfield, recorded with 71 microphones in several 3D arrays. A large download (about 24 GB in all).
licence: Open access. See the licence on its download page.

name: Sonic Palimpsest
by: University of Kent (A Sonic Palimpsest project)
what: Seven historic spaces at Chatham Dockyard, Kent: a working shipyard for 500 years, now a museum often used as a film location.
licence: Free to download and use, including in film sound and post. See the project's page for its terms.

name: Voxengo IM Reverbs
what: A small, handy pack of reverb impulses.
licence: Royalty-free for any use, including commercial. The files may not be sold or redistributed for profit.
